topic: Tessendorf Gerstner trochoidal wave Jacobian limiter vs over-steepened crest self-intersection loop rig
topic_zh: Tessendorf 摆线海浪雅可比正定陡度限幅对比朴素超陡 Gerstner 波峰倒扣自交环
scope: Deterministic Jerry Tessendorf (SIGGRAPH 2001) analytic trochoidal Gerstner wave Jacobian limiting (J(phi) = 1 - Q_safe * cos(phi) > 0) versus naive unclamped over-steepened Gerstner waves (J_naive(phi) = 1 - Q_raw * cos(phi) < 0) and 64-substep central finite-difference mesh tangent evaluation across 17 wave phase stations (phi in [-180 deg, +180 deg]). No neural fluid simulation execution.

protocol.function: J(φ) = dx / dφ = 1 − Q_safe · cos φ > 0 → Crest J(0°) = +0.2000 (5.00× Pinch, 0.0000 Loop Inversion)

robustness.name: Sampled 17 wave phase stations maintain strictly positive surface Jacobian J > 0 without crest self-intersection loops

good_fit: Real-time ocean water systems (Gerstner wave sums and Tessendorf FFT choppiness displacement) in UE5, Unity HDRP, Frostbite, and Three.js
Pinching rounded sine waves into sharp trochoidal ocean crests with wide troughs while preventing Σ Q_i > 1 mesh inversion loops
Using the surface Jacobian determinant J = (1+∂D_x/∂x)(1+∂D_z/∂z) − (∂D_x/∂z)² to drive physically plausible whitecap breaker foam
Computing exact analytical normals N = (−Q·sin φ, 1 − Q·cos φ) in vertex/compute shaders without finite-difference neighbors
not_for: Overturning 3D plunging surf tubes that physically require multi-valued Lagrangian SPH or Eulerian VOF fluid solvers
Calm flat puddles with zero horizontal choppiness (Q = 0)
Neural fluid physics or video diffusion water generation
